$comment: The hobbies chapter. Photos: put image files in public/photos/ and add one entry per photo ({ "src": "photos/name.jpg", "alt": "what is in the picture", "caption": "optional", "place": "optional", "date": "YYYY-MM, optional" }). While the list is empty the page shows `emptySlots` empty frames.

cycling.text: When I'm not running, I'm riding. Cycling is the other half of my training, and the sport I love enough to build a whole website about.

photography.text: I also take photos. This is my library: the pictures I want to keep.
